policy: At least {{min}} characters. Any characters, spaces too – a few words are easy to remember. Common passwords are refused.
policyTooShort: The password must have at least {{min}} characters.
policyTooShortMore_one: At least {{min}} characters – {{count}} more to go.
policyTooShortMore_other: At least {{min}} characters – {{count}} more to go.

setup.title: Set up {{brand}}
setup.intro: Choose a master passphrase and create the first administrator account.
setup.introExistingVault: This installation has no user accounts yet. Enter the existing master passphrase and create the first administrator.
setup.passphraseInfo: The master passphrase encrypts all platform credentials and signs the audit log. It is needed after every restart to unlock the tool (or provide it in a file: SM_MASTER_PASSPHRASE_FILE). It cannot be recovered – keep it safe, e.g. in your company password manager.
setup.passphraseRuleMore_one: At least 12 characters – {{count}} more to go.
setup.passphraseRuleMore_other: At least 12 characters – {{count}} more to go.
setup.passphraseTooShort: The passphrase must have at least {{count}} characters.

login.title: Sign in to {{brand}}
login.vaultLocked: The vault is locked. After signing in, an administrator can unlock it.
login.ssoOnly: Sign in with your company account.
login.ssoOnlyNoProvider: Password sign-in is turned off and no single sign-on provider is enabled. An administrator can get in with emergency access from the server's command line.
login.emergencyLink: Emergency access (administrators, with a link from the server)

changePassword.newPasswordsDiffer: The new passwords do not match.

forced.title: Choose a new password
forced.intro: Welcome {{name}}. Your account uses a temporary password – please choose your own before continuing.

vault.waitingIntro: {{brand}} was restarted and its vault is locked. An administrator has to unlock it with the master passphrase before you can continue.
vault.unlockIntro: Enter the master passphrase to decrypt credentials, verify the audit log and start schedules.

errors.SSO_FAILED: The sign-in with your company account did not work. Try again, or ask an administrator.
errors.SSO_STATE_UNKNOWN: The sign-in attempt expired or was started in another browser. Please try again.
errors.SSO_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: This sign-in provider is not available. Choose another one, or ask an administrator.
errors.SSO_VAULT_LOCKED: Single sign-on is not available until an administrator unlocks the vault.
errors.SSO_IDP_ERROR: The identity provider did not sign you in. Try again, or ask an administrator.
errors.SSO_SIGN_IN_REFUSED: Your sign-in was refused. Ask an administrator.
errors.SSO_SIGN_IN_REFUSED_reference: Your sign-in was refused. Ask an administrator and give them the reference {{reference}}.

emergency.title: Emergency access
emergency.intro: This one-time link was created on the server with steward admin emergency-access. It works once, within its time window.
emergency.codeHint: The part after #code= in the link the command printed.
emergency.signedIn: You are signed in already. Sign out first to use an emergency access link.
emergency.banner: Emergency access – fix the sign-in, then sign out. This session ends at {{time}} at the latest; your actions are marked in the audit log and the other administrators were notified.

stepUp.title: Confirm it is you
stepUp.why_one: This is a sensitive action. Confirm it is you – the confirmation then applies to all sensitive actions of this session for {{count}} minute.
stepUp.why_other: This is a sensitive action. Confirm it is you – the confirmation then applies to all sensitive actions of this session for {{count}} minutes.
stepUp.ssoHint: Sign in again with {{provider}}. A new window opens; Steward goes on once you are signed in.
stepUp.ssoHintMfa: Sign in again with {{provider}}, with a second factor (multi-factor authentication). A new window opens; Steward goes on once you are signed in.
stepUp.none: This session cannot confirm it: its sign-in provider is not available any more. Sign out and sign in again.
